# 安全问题 · Security

如果你发现番外或它的服务（fanwai.xyz、api.fanwai.xyz）有安全问题，比如能绕过体验码的限额、读到别人的数据，或者这个仓库里有不该公开的密钥，请在本仓库的 [Security › Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/ansonlianson/fanwai/security/advisories/new) 私下提交，不要公开发布。收到后会尽快回复，修好之后再公开细节。

只维护最新的 TestFlight 版本。

If you find a security problem in Fanwai or its services, please report it privately through [Security › Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/ansonlianson/fanwai/security/advisories/new) instead of disclosing it publicly. Only the latest TestFlight build is supported.
